editorial.description_en: A near-white with a cool cast, the colour of frost before the sun reaches it. The coolest of the three off-whites here.
editorial.description_ja: 朝の霜のような、青みのうすい白。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.935, C 0.005, h 246.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 薄 (usu, thin) + 霜 (shimo, frost). It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Thin Frost" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 薄霜. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — asa-moya at ΔE00 4.2, usu-gami at ΔE00 4.3, kai-jiro at ΔE00 5.6. complementary is empty because at chroma 0.005 the hue is not a reliable enough statement to oppose. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
